message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供實時黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格與圖表 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞、即時行情與分析 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 全球商品市場報價 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 24/7 交易所行情與技術分析 |
| **Yahoo Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 黃金期貨合約價格與歷史走勢 |

這些網站都會以美元（USD）為單位顯示即時價格，並且大多數都提供「今日收盤價」或「最新報價」的資訊。若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述任一平台查看。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Kitco, Bloomberg, etc.
